title: Model Selection for Gaussian-gated Gaussian Mixture of Experts Using Dendrograms of Mixing Measures
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical study of the statistical properties and model selection criteria for Gaussian-gated Gaussian Mixture of Experts (GGMoE) models. It focuses on mathematical proofs and synthetic data simulations related to convergence rates and parameter estimation, with no mention of religious, moral, or ethical benchmarking.
